title: Warp Special #1 Chaos Prince of Madness First Comics 1983 Frank Brunner
conditionDescription: Light handling wear; back cover lightly toned. See photos.
descriptionText:
Warp Special #1: Chaos, Prince of Madness! (July 1983), First Comics - "The (Not-So) Secret Origin of Prince Chaos!" Frank Brunner cover. $1.00 cover price.

Back cover: Geppi's Comic World ad with Wendy Pini ElfQuest art.

Condition: light handling wear; back cover lightly toned (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
